acceptanceCriteria: The rb1796-aff1.json plan is analysed: each widening witness kind is counted and attributed
Over-selection causes are fixed or linked to existing tickets (V1-1766, V1-1006) with the fixture reproduced as a regression test
A schema-ID constant bump selects only readers of that constant
body: Lane V1-1796 ran corvint affected --base 70a21da5d on a diff touching only internal/contextindex (receipt.go toolchainCommand area, analyzer_schema.go) and cmd/corvint/affected.go plus specs/conformance; the plan selected 157 units across about 35 packages, too broad to use, so the lane fell back to hand-picked -run filters. Evidence: /private/tmp/cem10-build/rb1796-aff1.json (retain or copy before lane cleanup). Possible overlap with V1-1766 (PATH_LITERAL_READER basename readers) and V1-1006 (data literal binary-reader edges); the analyzer_schema.go schema-ID bump and the conformance receipt repin are likely fan-out sources. Expected: selection close to the reverse-import closure of the two packages, with every widening witness explained.
title: corvint affected selected 157 units across ~35 packages for a two-package change (V1-1796 lane, rc.3 build 634)
